Data Dictionary

Metric definitions and business rules. Each entry explains what a number on a dashboard means and how it is counted.

How to use this page

  1. Search for the name you see on a dashboard, or a topic such as “enrollment” or “A1c”.
  2. Read “What it means” in the table. Click a name to see the full definition, the people and dates it counts, and any notes.
  3. Not sure about a term? Open the Glossary (for example CIN, ECM+, PAM, or PROD). Underlined terms in the table show their meaning when you point at them.

Try: Enrollment Conversion Rate · Pathway · Members with ECM+ encounters · A1c baseline · Sourcing eligibility

This site explains definitions only. It does not connect to BigQuery and does not show member data. 677 entries from 10 approved definition files.
